resources.string: Shows the Voicio bubble over text fields and types what you dictate into the field you are using. Voicio reads only the focused field. Your voice stays on this phone unless you turn on an optional cloud provider yourself.
A bubble sits next to any text field. Say what you mean, and Voicio types it into whatever app you\'re in. Setup takes about two minutes.
